See the drone show and the tree lighting
site: Centennial Park & Amphitheater, 120 E Ocean Ave
about: The city is calling this the 55th Annual Holiday Tree Lighting, and it carries a whimsical, wonderland-inspired theme through downtown Boynton Beach.
City communications say Boynton Beach is making history this year by combining the Holiday Parade performances and the Annual Holiday Tree Lighting into one celebration for the first time ever.
The program runs for six hours, from 4 PM to 10 PM, and the city lists admission as free. A spectacular drone show is part of the lineup.

Families will find a Kids Zone sponsored by Baptist Health South Florida, children's performances, favorite holiday characters, food vendors and festive photo opportunities before the city's holiday tree is lit.
The tree lighting is the opening event of the city's December holiday calendar, which continues with the Holiday Boat Parade on December 11 and Breakfast with Santa on December 12.
Centennial Park & Amphitheater sits at 120 E Ocean Ave in the heart of downtown, and the city's Holidays in Boynton Beach page keeps the full list of December events in one place.

Because the city folded the parade performances into the tree lighting, families get one long evening downtown instead of two separate trips, and the six hour window lets young children come early for the Kids Zone while older kids wait for the drone show.
faq: When is the Boynton Beach tree lighting in 2026?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, with the celebration running from 4 PM to 10 PM.

Centennial Park & Amphitheater, 120 E Ocean Ave, Boynton Beach, Florida 33435.

Yes. The city lists admission to the celebration as free.

For the first time, the city combines the Holiday Parade performances and the 55th Annual Holiday Tree Lighting into one event.

There is a Kids Zone sponsored by Baptist Health South Florida, plus children's performances, holiday characters and photo spots.
Is there a drone show?
Yes. The city's announcement lists a spectacular drone show as part of the evening.

The Holiday Boat Parade on December 11 and Breakfast with Santa on December 12.
Do I need tickets for the tree lighting?
No ticket is listed. The city describes the celebration as free admission, so families can simply arrive at Centennial Park & Amphitheater between 4 PM and 10 PM.
Who sponsors the Kids Zone?
Baptist Health South Florida sponsors the Kids Zone, according to the city's holiday announcement.
Is food available?
Yes. Food vendors are part of the downtown celebration.

kids: Watch decorated boats glide along the Intracoastal
Bring a toy for Marine Toys for Tots
site: Boynton Harbor Marina, 735 Casa Loma Blvd
about: Boynton Harbor Marina is named by the city as the official Boynton Beach watch location for the annual Holiday Boat Parade.
The marina watch party runs from 6 to 9 PM and includes holiday music, activities, food and a special visit from Santa.
The parade is presented in partnership with the Town of Lantana, the Town of Hypoluxo and the City of Delray Beach, so boats pass through several communities along the Intracoastal Waterway.
The Delray Beach city calendar says the boats start traveling south in Lantana at about 6:30 PM and finish at the C-15 Canal south of Linton Boulevard.
Boat captains who want to join register through December 4. The entry donation is one new, unwrapped toy that benefits Marine Toys for Tots, and guests are encouraged to bring a toy as well.
Boynton Beach also posts a Holiday Boat Parade listing on its Holidays in Boynton Beach page, alongside the tree lighting on December 5 and Breakfast with Santa on December 12.

Families who cannot get to the marina can also catch the parade from other points along the route, since the Delray Beach calendar lists passing times of 7:45 PM at George Bush Boulevard, 8:00 PM at Atlantic Avenue and 8:15 PM at Linton Boulevard.
faq: When is the Boynton Beach Holiday Boat Parade in 2026?
Friday, December 11, 2026. The marina watch party runs from 6 to 9 PM.

The Delray Beach city calendar also lists Deck 84 at 840 E Atlantic Ave as a Delray Beach watch location.

kids: Share your wish list with Santa and his Signing Elf
Make a holiday craft to take home
about: Boynton Beach Recreation and Parks lists Breakfast with Santa on the city calendar for Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 9 to 11 AM at Intracoastal Park.
The city's description says Santa and his Signing Elf are rolling into town for a magical celebration that will light up faces of every age.
Little ones can take pictures with Santa, share their wish lists and get creative making a one-of-a-kind holiday craft to take home.
Grown-ups are invited to bring cameras and holiday cheer, because the city promises smiles for everyone.
The calendar entry lists the cost as $18 for residents and $23 for nonresidents and links a Register Here button, and it marks the event as ADA accessible.
The address on the city calendar is 138 Harbors Way, Boynton Beach, Florida 33435, with the Intracoastal Park facility page linked from the listing.
Breakfast with Santa follows the tree lighting on December 5 and the Holiday Boat Parade on December 11 in the city's December lineup.
The listing names the Signing Elf alongside Santa, and the craft gives children something to take home after the photos.
